training_setup.learning_rate_schedule: cosine annealing per epoch from 0.1 to ~0 over 60 epochs (no restarts)
training_setup.augmentation: random crop 32x32 with 4-px zero padding + random horizontal flip

task3.method: rank-average ensemble of 3 signals: (a) 3-fold cross-validated confidence 1-p(noisy label), (b) negative area-under-margin of the Task-1 CE run up to the early-stop epoch, (c) DivideMix per-sample loss (2 nets) - 5 training runs total
